title: New research engineer joined our lab
body: We are thrilled to announce that Mansitha Eashwara has joined our lab as a Research Engineer.

title: Acceptances at MobiSys 2026
body: We are thrilled to announce that a demo and a workshop paper have been accepted at MobiSys 2026.

title: Our paper accepted at CHI 2026
body: We are thrilled to announce that our paper titled 'Motor-Mediated Creativity: Bridging Embodied Skill Training and Digital Expression' has been accepted to be presented at CHI 2026.
